title: Affine spectrum comparison square on the canonical representative
statement: Let f:X→S, fprime:Xprime→Sprime, g:Sprime→S, gprime:Xprime→X form a cartesian square of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], with a cartesian square of spectrum maps on global sections. Choose derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], a point z0∈Spec Γ(Xprime,⊤), i∈Z, K-flat complexes P on X and Q on Spec Γ(X,⊤), with Q equal to termwise tensor pullback of P along X.isoSpec.inv [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Assume the two recorded pullback counits along gprime and its spectrum map are invertible [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Put z=Xprime.isoSpec.inv(z0), H and H0 the respective derived stalk cohomology functors, and F and F0 their scalar forgetful functors. Let d:Qloc(Q)≅L(X.isoSpec.inv)*Qloc(P) be equality transport along Q followed by the inverse specified isoPullbackComplexCounitIso. There is an additive source isomorphism l such that l;F0(comparisonIntoPullback(Q);H0(Lg0prime*(d))) equals F(comparisonIntoPullback(P));T(Lgprime*Qloc(P));F0(H0(affineSpectrumDerivedPullbackIso(gprime).inv at Qloc(P))), where T is the explicitly constructed isoPullbackStalkCohomologyIso [lem-pc-iso-pullback-stalk-cohomology], and the affine coordinates and comparisons are [def-pc-affine-spectrum-derived-coordinates, lem-pc-stalk-comparison-pullback-naturality]. No arbitrary derived representative isomorphism or coefficient morphism occurs.

proof.text: Identify the four stalk rings and ring maps using isoSpec naturality and stalkMap_comp. Check tensorMap on the two tensor inclusions. The germ formula for tensorPullback_stalk_iso identifies the input stalk complex of Q with scalar extension of P along the stalk ring isomorphism.

Transport the universal left-derived R-to-B scalar extension along the ring isomorphisms and their inverse restriction equivalences. Apply homology and use cohomologyIso_smul to obtain the full tensor-algebra action, then extend to C and forget scalars to get l and its inverse.

The model equations comparison_eq and localized_eq give the counit square. The tensorStalkIso germ formula and isoPullbackStalkCohomologyIso identify ordinary and exact derived stalk factors. The leftDerivedLift defining equation fixes the composition comparison as affineSpectrumDerivedPullbackIso.inv. Combine these equations with the canonical counit d.

theorem exists_affineSpectrum_canonicalComparison_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X'] [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    (sq0 : IsPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop))
    (z0 : Spec Γ(X', ⊤)) (i : ℤ)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec Γ(X, ⊤)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : P.IsKFlat) (hQ : Q.IsKFlat)
    (hcP : IsIso ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
    (hcQ : IsIso ((counit (Spec.map g'.appTop)).app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q)))
    (hQ0 : Q = ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj P) :
    let z := X'.isoSpec.inv z0
    let H0 := comparisonStalkCohomology (Spec Γ(X', ⊤)) z0 i
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk z)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F0 := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((Spec Γ(X', ⊤)).presheaf.stalk z0))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let d : DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q ≅
        affineSpectrumDerivedObject X (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) :=
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun W ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.obj W) hQ0) ≪≫
        (isoPullbackComplexCounitIso X.isoSpec.inv).symm.app P
      ∃ l : F.obj (Arrow.mk (comparisonIntoPullback f f' g g' sq z P hcP i)).left ≅
          F0.obj (Arrow.mk
            (comparisonIntoPullback (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
              (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0 Q hcQ i)).left,
        l.hom ≫ F0.map
          (comparisonIntoPullback (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
            (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0 Q hcQ i ≫
              H0.map ((derivedPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop)).map d.hom)) =
        F.map (comparisonIntoPullback f f' g g' sq z P hcP i) ≫
            (isoPullbackStalkCohomologyIso X'.isoSpec.inv z0 i).hom.app
              ((derivedPullback g').obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
              F0.map (H0.map ((affineSpectrumDerivedPullbackIso g').inv.app
                (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)))
